text:
Alex K.: Quick heads-up — code freeze at 18:00 UTC today for v1.12 cut. Please hold off on merges after that unless you have an exception.

Maya R.: Pushing one last changelog tweak — version bump PR #4827. Will hold if freeze enforced.

Chris L.: FYI my PR touches runtime batching, needs a minor test update. @release-admin can we get late-merge exception?

release-admin: Code freeze policy: exceptions permitted for P0 regressions or small doc/version bumps. To request an exception, post the PR + owner + justification. Must get 2 approvals and a trusted deployer sign-off.

Chris L.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4839 — 2-line test fix, no model changes. Owner: @chrisl. Requesting exception.

Sam T.: looked — minor; happy to review. @Linh P. can you do deployer sign-off?

Linh P.: can approve deployer for this one. But we need a quick regression run on main -> staging (5m).

Alex K.: run is in progress, tagging @qa-bot

qa-bot: Regression check started for PR 4839 on staging. ETA ~6m. Logs: http://ci.redwood/inv/4839/trace

Eva S.: If regression passes + 2 reviewer approvals, we can merge with exception and cherry-pick if needed.

Maya R.: Approved. @Alex K. approved.

Sam T.: Approved too :thumbsup:

qa-bot: Regression check passed. No new failures.

release-admin: Exception granted for PR 4839. Merge instructions: use squash merge, then create a release-hotfix branch and note in changelog. After merge run deploy.

Alex K.: Merge command:
```
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git merge --no-ff --squash pr/4839
git commit -m "chore: bump v1.12 changelog & test fix (PR#4839)"
git push origin main
```
then trigger `./scripts/deploy --staging`

Chris L.: Merged and kicked deploy at 1769543385. Thanks everyone!

release-admin: Logged exception. Remember to add release note: 'hotfix: test flake fix' and tag the PR in the release notes.

Maya R.: I'll add the changelog entry and note the exception in the cut notes.

Alex K.: All good — lifting freeze exception for this PR only. Back to full freeze. :lock:
